patterns_found.visual_evidence: The inferred interactive components include search, mobile navigation, accordion/sidebar disclosures, load-more controls, and possible modal overlays, all of which require managed keyboard focus.

sketch_notes: The sketches imply a blog/archive page with moderate JavaScript complexity: core interactions center on responsive navigation, header search, a validated subscription/contact form, and progressive access to more content. Mobile likely relies on a collapsed navigation pattern, while desktop shifts complexity toward expandable sidebar sections. Several behaviors are only implied rather than explicitly drawn, especially overlays for subscribe/share actions, but keyboard focus handling is clearly necessary across the inferred interactive components.
